note: House services distributed through the KILN forge. Every label below was read from the service itself or its release record at registration time (2026-11-19). The KILN /services surface re-reads each service's live discovery door at view time where the door is public, so live state wins over this file.

services.getStarted: Ask the operator for an API key (minting is operator-only), then POST /v1/wallets. Agents can also hire Coffer through the VaultNet service-agent desk (signed card, SDK in auro/agent-phone); the desk runs on demand, it is not an always-on process.
labels: charging off: 1,000 free requests/month, then $0.25 per 1,000 (metered, not charged)
never signs server-side: wallets receive and report; owners export keys and sign with their own tools
8 wallet types: operational, token, agent, watch, hd, evm, multisig, burner
wallets attach to services: every wallet carries its service attachment, queryable per service
trade: Jupiter swap + deBridge DLN bridge quote/build per wallet, platform fee 0
services.name: Coffer
services.tagline: Wallets & vaults API: production wallets by type, encrypted vaults, and unsigned swap/bridge builds. The wallet service the house's own agents run on.

services.getStarted: Create a merchant account at the door, mint an API key in the app, and start with a payment request. Full scope table on the developers page.
labels: protocol v1.14.0 (release record; the live door serves no version string)
beta: mainnet live, devnet test mode badged in the app
33 scopes / 72 routes; no money-out scope exists
non-custodial: Sendapay verifies settlement on-chain; the user signs everything
USDC note: settlement is in Circle-issued USDC/EURC on Solana using Circle's published mints; conversions run over Jupiter. Sendapay is not a Circle API integration.
services.name: Sendapay
services.tagline: The merchant money protocol: payment requests, checkout, storefronts, recurring, cards, entitlements. Settles in Circle-issued USDC on Solana.

services.doorNote: Fleet-local today: runs on the house host (127.0.0.1:8796, v1.0.0). No public door yet; builders on the house fleet use its local API. Docs are the repo README + INTEGRATION.md (auro/sends-engine).
services.getStarted: On the house fleet: GET /health, then the corridor quote routes. Off-fleet: read INTEGRATION.md in auro/sends-engine; a public door is future work, not a label.
labels: v1.0.0, live on the house host
providers: solana_native, relay, dln live; lifi key_required (waits on the house LI.FI key)
quote-only: signs nothing, sends nothing, custodies nothing
live persisted quotes: US to MX $100, recipient gets $100 via Solana native (fee $0.00036); Relay $99.9568 over DLN $99.9200 to Base
services.name: Sends engine
services.tagline: Money-movement quote engine: ranks real routes across corridors (US to MX proven) over Solana-native, Relay, and DLN providers. Quote-only: it signs, sends, and custodies nothing.
